title: Mixed Event — Secret Distance

meta.Outline: In hopes of pulling Kanade out of her songwriting slump, Mizuki plans a mystery tour for a much-needed change of pace. And so begins Nightcord at 25:00's first ever day trip together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Both the song and music video needed some fine tuning, but I thought they turned out well, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! This might even be my best work yet♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, considering how much time and attention you gave it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And about our next song. You know how we talked about some rough themes last time?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I came up with a few sketches based on those. Mind taking a look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? When did you make these? I thought you were busy editing your illustrations.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <While the video was in the final editing phase. Some ideas came into my head so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like someone's getting excited! Plus, you'll get a better picture after you hear more of the next song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sorry, about that...
I'm still working through a few ideas, so I'd like a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But there's still a bunch of time until our deadline, so you don't need to rush.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And... There, I've sent you my sketches...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Wow, you made a bunch...!
Aww, the third one's so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<...
I like the very last one.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. You have a good eye. I used one of the first pieces that this artist I like made as a reference...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Y-You...! I was just trying to explain how...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wouldn't have it any other way.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mhm...!
Everything's all wrapped up, so it's time for a good night's sleep♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But when Ena ran off to SEKAI that other time, I really didn't know what would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It looks like she's having a lot more fun now, so I'm happy for her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And finding out that her dad's some famous artist was a pretty big shock...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We've all been working together for a while now, but we still don't know anything about each other.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe if we did, Ena could've talked to us about it before it sort of spun out of control...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But we really only talk while we're all working or meeting about how things are going...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What if we went on another little excursion like that time we all went to that Doll Exhibit?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu kind of had it rough that time, but we got to know a little more about her in return.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe we can learn more about each other by going somewhere we usually don't...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's spring, so everyone goes to see cherry blossoms and stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's gotta be more fun than... That's it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This class is doing a haunted house!
The decorations are really good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I bet it would give Ena the creeps. Mafuyu doesn't seem the type to get spooked by this sort of stuff though.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As for Kanade, I wonder... I kind of want to see what she's like when something startles her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What about a haunted house or something?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just found that site with a list of haunted places and sort of been wanting to check them out...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like that really creepy tunnel or that spooky shrine...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's no way they'll say yes to just going around and seeing stuff like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I need a way to goad them into going...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So many customers today...
I guess they all wanna get new clothes since it's finally starting to warm up again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now, let's get to work!
A demo for the next song should be up by now... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <I'd like to meet in SEKAI today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Pretty rare of Kanade to ask us to go to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu, Ena!
You beat me here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But where's the sender... Oh, there she is!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not like you to ask us to meet here. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's okay, Kanade.
I'm not sure what's going on, but I'm on your side, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can you tell us what happened?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I haven't been able to finish the demo version...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said you've been working on it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, leave her alone. It's not like she wants to be in a slump or anything. No one does.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I understand completely. I have to draw and redraw something over and over again sometimes because I can't quite get an illustration to match the image I have in my head.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sometimes? Don't you mean all the time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So why are you all here...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, it's hard to ignore you when you're being so loud...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Didn't you say that it was fun when they all came here last time...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So why are you all here...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wasn't coming up with any ideas on my own, so I thought it'd be better to ask you all in person...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki and I don't know much about composing, but maybe Mafuyu can help...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nothing I say will make a difference...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to create a song that can save someone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was grasping at straws and hoping for a serendipity maybe but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What if you tried doing something new or different...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's right. You won't get anywhere at this rate. What if you did something that you've never done before?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You all gathered to greet me, I see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is nuts!
First Rin and now MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right? And that doll the other time too. Everything just seems to appear out of thin air here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But at the very least, we can all get to know each other and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let me just start by saying that I'd rather not get involved anything...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku and Rin should be more than enough for now, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I plan to keep my distance and observe how things go for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please, act as if I'm not even here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can ignore me and continue your conversation...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe a little bit, but we can come back to that later...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm Mizuki Akiyama!
Starting from your left, this is Kanade, Mafuyu and Ena! Nice to meet you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just said that you should ignore me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you should at least know our names, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, we should try something new so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And I have a suggestion!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about we all go on a one-day mystery tour?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a kind of trip where you have no idea where you're actually going, or something along those lines...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll come up with where we'll be going, so all you have to do is follow me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I promise that it'll be jam-packed with fun surprises! How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If we go to a bunch of places we've never been to before, Kanade might be able come up with some good ideas, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too. Anything if it helps Kanade with her music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right... We should be doing everything we can for this song...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Get ready for an amazing mystery tour! I'll let you guys know when I get everything in place!
The day of the mystery tour

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there they are!
Heeey! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*... So sleepy...
How can you have this much energy this early?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, Mafuyu! Looks like everyone's right on time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So let's get this show on the road♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just where exactly are you taking us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd sorta stop being a mystery tour if I told you, wouldn't it? You'll just have to wait and find out♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We've been on this thing for an eternity...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can't you just tell us where we're going already? All I see are farms and rice paddies now. Are we going into the mountains or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Patience is a virtue, Ena.
You should be trying to imagine what sort of fun-filled adventure I have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But we're almost there...
Maybe this is a good time to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, finally. You've already made us wait this long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We'll be checking out a haunted area that everyone's been talking about♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Relax. There's a reason I picked this place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember how I met Ena's li'l bro during the School Festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: His class did a haunted house that time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I thought a little test of courage might do us some good♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But the truth is that you just want to go, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's another way to put it☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If it'll help Kanade with her music, I don't think where we go matters.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for putting you all through this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, Kanade, don't say that!
Blame Mizuki for dragging us all the way out here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's totally okay!
I've sort of been wanting to go on a trip with everyone like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And relax, Ena!
This place might be haunted, but there's supposed to be a ton of good photo ops too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's not what I have a problem with!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This place... I'm starting to get a bad feeling...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, are we gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Perfect! This place really doesn't disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This spot in particular seems to be pretty famous. They say that a bunch of accidents and stuff keep happening here because people keep seeing ghosts!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, here's that hole they were talking about. Apparently, a car crashed right into here. Pretty eerie...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...? So you're saying that a ghost made that crash happen...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um...
If we're doing a horror theme...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The intro can include a double bass, people screaming in a few places and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: S-See! It won't really help her! We don't have to go in!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you think that song can save anyone?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Geez, this tunnel's so long...
It's the middle of the day, but pitch black in here...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. They say that the ghost here is of a woman with really long hair...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They say that she looks like a regular person, so people end up asking her if something's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She apparently mumbles some stuff and these people always end up trying to hear what she's saying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the ones who heard her speak all ended up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! What do you mean, Who Knows?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And why are you telling us that in a place like this?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Okay, sorry.
We'll be fine. I promise.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It ran off in that direction.
It kicked the can and made it rattle.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*... Just a tanuki?
I got worked up over nothing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You should've seen the look on your face...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Where's Kanade?
She was right next to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, are you sure?
Heeey! Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She's not responding...
Where'd she go?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She might be lost. We can't just leave her like this! I'll go look while you two head for the exit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What do I do...?
But the exit's right here, so as long as I can make it there...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Eep!
Oh, nevermind. It was just a leaf...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is someone there?
Mizuki and Mafuyu went the other way so...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, Th-The Pain...?
No, is this what Mizuki was...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? That sounded like Ena!
We should go back!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena! Are you okay?! What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Something startled me and I just started running. I ended up outside but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You did?! But you didn't answer when I called your name...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... I sort of twisted my ankle while I was running, and kind of couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, sorry.
How do you feel, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I can walk now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
That means we can keep going!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, there's more...?
Can't we just call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If Kanade thinks she can make her song now, then okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I'm not sure I can yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, but can we just get out of here already?! I can tell you this tunnel's not doing me any favors!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Sure.
You two seem like you've had your fill, so off to our next stop!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I feel bad for letting them be all by themselves like that. It's probably best to just stick together from now on.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I got to see a part of them that I usually never would.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This place is pretty creepy too...
At least we're outside and not in that tunnel anymore.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It looks like a normal shrine.
How is it haunted?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This place is also known as the Cursed Shrine of Separation!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A long time ago, a big influential family with a pair of sisters used to live here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They were totally inseparable and meant everything to each other, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: One day, while they were out playing hide and seek, a fire broke out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The two sisters desperately looked for one another, but before they could, they were gone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They say that because these two sisters died while still separated, they hate those that can be with their loved ones...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They say that if two people who really care about each other come here, they end up drifting apart...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To try to put their souls to rest, this shrine was build.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, even after everyone put all this work into building this shrine, those girls still want to curse people...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That doesn't make any sense. I find it hard to believe that any pair of siblings would end up cursing people in death because they were so close in life.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Me and big sis are pretty close.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's right, you mentioned that you have an older sister. She lives overseas, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! She's a lot older than me, but we get along really well!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But Ena might be right. I doubt we'd end up cursing anyone like those sisters from that story.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right?
Even with my little brother, I really can't imagine anything like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, absolutely nothing like that will ever happen...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, I doubt your li'l bro would!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it is kinda sweet that they want to be together that much even in death...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you guys have anyone like that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Someone you don't ever want to be away from! Someone that you want to be with so much that you'd curse anyone that made you be away from them!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I respect someone quite a lot, but not to the point of cursing other people...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I have some close friends, but not to that degree...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess you wouldn't right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. The same goes for me too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So that means we shouldn't be cursed then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup, exactly!
I guess we should thank our stars that we don't have anyone in our lives like that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure we should be celebrating...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess the silver lining is that we're all kind of alike, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyways, Kanade...
Do you know what you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've gotten some ideas, but nothing I can turn into a song...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right, okay...
How about we head to our last stop then?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why did you say those things the way you did?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You said, Please, act as if I'm not even here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. If you'd like to learn more about everyone else, I think you should actually talk to them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. I suppose that is an option...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there are also things you become blind to by getting too close...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to maintain my distance and observe them for now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those three can freely enter and exit this SEKAI as well, even though it's made entirely out of Mafuyu's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those three must mean just that much to her. She can't be without them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But those three each also have something on their minds, and I'd like to know what that could be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially... Mizuki... I sense a great weight there...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But still, I just sort of got the feeling we were somehow alike.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That part that feels like we might be able to change ourselves a bit at a time to fit in with those around us, and the confusion at whether we should resist or accept it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then getting so tired from trying so hard that nothing seems to matter anymore. I feel like we're similar in that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One time, Mizuki even mentioned to Mafuyu that, We were somehow alike...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu is usually silent around Miku, while Mizuki is the opposite with me and even tries to put ribbons in my hair and such.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure. Maybe I have a lot in common with them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh...?
If that's the case then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Our last stop for the day is here♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade! We're not going home until you have a solid idea for a song, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This used to be a school...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Apparently, the ghost of a dead student still haunts the music room.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They say that she was so good, she competed in national competitions...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everyone had such high hopes for her, but one day, she just buckled under the pressure and ended up dying.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Originally, this school was supposed to be demolished, but people ended up getting hurt when they intruded, so that idea got scrapped...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again, you tell us these things at the worst times...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! We're on a haunted mystery tour, right? It's all in good fun...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe this is what was best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's alone and finally free now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because it's so much easier that way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That hardly feels like something you should say while we're on a trip like this...
Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
M-Mafuyu, wait!
We've gotta go after her!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She didn't go inside, did she?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The doors are locked and I don't think there's an easy way in through the windows...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna go look over there!
You two keep sending her messages and wait by the gate!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She isn't here either...
What if she really went inside...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But all the doors and windows are shut. I just have to hope that she's still out here somewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe this is what was best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's alone and finally free now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because it's so much easier that way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I doubt this'll work...
But it might be worth a shot...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It might be better that I don't find her here, but if something like that other time happens again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, have you seen Mafuyu?
We were out doing something together and thought she might've come here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If she did come here, we'd definitely know it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was worried that something was bothering her and decided to come here, but I'm glad I was wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, where on earth could she be?
I hope she isn't hurt or anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You care about Mafuyu and the others quite a lot, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess I do.
We make music together and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well, you know...?
I feel like we get along pretty well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'd be nice if you could all stay together like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can keep making songs and go on trips like this from time to time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyways, I should head back and find Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that I know she wasn't in SEKAI, she's officially a little girl that's lost...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I should go back to where we got separated and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We came to tell you that we found Mafuyu wandering around over there. Kanade should be with her now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does she always end up doing this, honestly...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! Do you know how much time we spent looking for you?! Don't wander off on us like that, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You are...? O-Okay...
As long as you understand...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Were you looking at the cherry blossoms?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I couldn't get myself to turn away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't understand. It's like cherry blossoms look prettier than they always have...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I get that this tree's really huge, but they just look like regular old cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The last time I saw cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: New Student A
rows.Line: Look at those cherry blossom trees...! I can't believe they're this close to our school...!

rows.Speaker: New Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, are you a new student too?
Wanna walk to school together?

rows.Speaker: New Student A
rows.Line: O-Okay, sure! I actually felt a little scared about going all alone so...

rows.Speaker: New Student B
rows.Line: Then I'm glad we met! I hope we're in the same class too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, they're new. That's why I didn't recognize them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They say spring's a time for meeting new people...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But even if you do, they all just...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Look, they're all blooming! They're so pretty! Why can't they just stay like this?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Well, at least they'll be here again next year.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yup! We can come back together even after we graduate.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Haha. Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself? But I guess there's no getting rid of you either.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, we're thinking about seeing all the cherry blossoms later. Wanna come?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line: Don't worry. I went in knowing that I'd get turned down.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How can anyone think that they're this pretty?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How can these look so beautiful...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're just flowers in full bloom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not fair how they get to end this way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I sort of understand what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They almost seem too pretty. It almost feels strange to think of them as plant life.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We have to struggle so much every day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Right. I get it now.
That's why they look so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're so pretty that it's unfair...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's a part of each of us that isn't really normal...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But that's also why we're together like this now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That reminds me, if these cherry blossoms are already blooming, that means a new term's about to start...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you think would happen if we ended up being in the same class?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The same class?
Hmm... That's hard to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'd have to do P.E. and stuff together, right? I really can't see us doing that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
P.E...?
I don't like being tired, so I'd rather not...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then I can help you build up some stamina!
Exercising's my forte after all♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand that it's good to have stamina, but if it means being tired then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I knew you'd say that! But ask me anytime if you want to learn how to have fun workouts!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And we can ask Mafuyu about any actual schoolwork, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can only show her what the answers are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, that completely defeats the point!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you think our class would be like if we were all together?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena would be late every day...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? I'm right here, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you'd show up for every art class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She would! Plus, the way she shrugs and grunts and yells, ”This isn't right!” would really get on other people's nerves!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? No way, I really do those things...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You forget to mute yourself sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sometimes? She does it fairly often...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
But you're working so hard, and I kinda like hearing what you're up to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're one to talk.
I mean, you're always...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew, I'm spent. We just ended up chatting like always in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did we really need to come all the way out to this creepy place if you knew this would happen...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I can make our song now too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. All thanks to you showing us around all these places and telling us those stories, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. Your song's gonna include stuff from those stories?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I learned that there are people that couldn't be saved or can't rest in peace, like those sisters from the shrine or the girl from the school...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought about what sort of songs would be able to save each of them and an image popped into my head...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I learned that you, Kanade and Ena, were bigger scaredy cats than I realized too, but I'm glad things worked out in the end for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How did being scared help me...? But I guess I can draw some inspiration from those cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um, are we okay for time...?
I remember someone saying the last bus comes at 5...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We went somewhere I normally wouldn't go so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you really feel that way, you could let it show a little more, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena's emotions were on full display.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course they were! This place was unbelievably creepy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad they all had a good time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I had a lot of fun today too. Especially when I got to see a part of everyone I normally wouldn't.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope we can keep doing stuff like this... Maybe next year we can... Next year...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Today was so much fun that I thought we could do something like this next year...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My chest feels tight... I can't say anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I forgot what I was about to say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Aren't you a little too young for that to start happening?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And the bus is gonna be here any minute. We need to hurry!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why wasn't I able to say what I wanted...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They seem pretty tired. I can't imagine them walking around this much on a daily basis...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade and Ena always do everything at night, while Mafuyu goes to school during the day...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad they agreed to join me here today...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'll come up with something less strenuous next time...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This has to be a first. I don't think I've ever thought about doing anything with anybody years into the future...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Until now, I never really cared about anything like that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was content with things as long as I was having fun. I thought that's how things would be from now on...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This feeling... It's making my chest feel a little tight...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'd be nice if you could all stay together like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(If we do...
Will I have to tell them...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Do I have to tell them that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even though I really want to be with them next year too, there's a part of me that thinks it won't work out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess that's why I'm scared to tell them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We won't really be friends unless I do tell them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (You said that you wanted to learn more about everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it turns out that I'm the one keeping the most secrets...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming, everyone!
It got dark before we knew it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You sort of did end up on your side while you slept, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You need to get home before the rest of your family does, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We could head over to our usual diner...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about we call it a day? I'm sure you're both tired from walking around so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You might be right. My feet are starting to hurt too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See? We should all go home, take a nice, long bath and get in a good massage!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah. Thank you, Mizuki.
I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, don't you live down that way too? Is there still something you need to do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I can't put my finger on it...
But are you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me? Why, do I look tired?
Wait, do I have dark circles or something?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's not what I'm talking about...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good! You had me worried there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I might be more tired than I realize. We did walk a ton today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for worrying about me, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure that you're okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm fine! I'm fine!
Don't be such a worrywart!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you're probably a lot more tired than I am, so you should head home and get a good night's sleep in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I should go check out that shop I've been wanting to see. I'll see you later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Um, yeah... Okay...
I'll send you some stuff for the song tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wasn't just seeing things, right...?
